newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to lift LPG price freeze from July - report.
newsitem.headline: Spain to lift LPG price freeze from July - report.

text.p: Spain's Industry Ministry is to lift in July a freeze in the price of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), considering that it has played its part in limiting inflation, the financial daily Expansion reported on Monday.
No one at the Industry Ministry was available to comment.

The newspaper said the September decree capping the price of LPG had caused Repsol, which has almost full control over the market for butane canisters, losses of 21.0 billion pesetas to April this year.
